annotationMethod: Coarse yaw intervals and target rectangles chosen by visual review before temporal pipeline inference. Original and mirrored/cropped model outputs are not ground truth. Unknown on a visible view is a miss, not a correct negative.
regressionPolicy: Minimum supported counts preserve actually measured positive controls; they are not ground-truth visibility labels. All twelve reviewed frames have a visible target body, including the six currently unresolved back views.
